verdict.rationale: Stripe's Disputes API lets finance-ops programmatically manage disputes, upload structured evidence, respond to disputes, and receive dispute lifecycle events via webhooks, plus dispute events surface in the Dashboard/Radar for tracking; MCP tooling also exposes a 'disputes: update' method for agent-assisted workflows. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on account of the full evidence-submission UX or explicit dispute-resolution outcome tracking beyond webhook events.
